Video: Timo Lenzen



Caitlin Talbot

Culture correspondent



 There’s a strange little art to spotting AI writing. Large language models enjoy, for instance, using odd phrases like “strange little art”. Yet some of AI’s writing tricks are trickier to catch. Many people believe LLMs stuff their prose with unnecessarily long, grandiloquent words—and use too many em-dashes. Stock exposure is no longer limited to a traditional brokerage account. On Bybit, users can access selected stock and ETF exposure through three different products: xStocks, TradFi CFDs, and TradFi Perpetual Contracts. Each product serves a different type of trader depending on the strategy, risk appetite, and preferred market access. xStocks: Tokenized Stock Exposure xStocks are 1:1 backed tokenized stocks and ETFs designed for users who want tokenized exposure to selected equities. They trade 24/7, settle in USDT, and can be transferred on-chain across supported networks. They do not offer leverage, short selling, funding rates, or overnight swap costs. Best for users who want longer-term tokenized exposure without leverage. TradFi CFDs: Active Stock Trading With MT5 TradFi CFDs give users price exposure to selected stocks without owning the underlying shares. They are available through MetaTrader 5 via Bybit and support both long and short positions. Traders can also access leverage, technical tools, Expert Advisors, copy trading features, and dividend adjustments. Trading generally follows traditional market hours from Monday to Friday. Best for active traders who want leverage, shorting, and MT5 tools. TradFi Perpetuals: 24/7 Stock Exposure TradFi Perpetual Contracts are USDT-denominated perpetual contracts that track selected stocks, ETFs, and other traditional market assets. They support long and short positions, use funding rates instead of overnight swaps, and trade 24/7. This makes them useful for traders who want to react to earnings, macro news, or market movement even when traditional stock markets are closed. Best for crypto-native traders who want 24/7 TradFi exposure with leverage and flexibility. Which One Fits Your Strategy? Choose xStocks if you want tokenized exposure without leverage. Choose TradFi CFDs if you want leverage, shorting, MT5 access, and active trading tools. Choose TradFi Perpetuals if you want 24/7 access, long or short flexibility, and USDT-settled execution. Each product gives traders a different way to access selected stock and ETF exposure from one Bybit account. Key Risks All three products carry market risk. Leveraged products such as TradFi CFDs and TradFi Perpetuals carry higher risk because gains and losses are amplified.
